name: 02-audio-write-read
description: Baseline continuous round trip. Lane A commits three 1024-sample batches a second apart; lane B reads the newest batch non-blocking, blocks for one that does not exist yet and must wake on the commit, then lets a deadline expire on an unreachable index.

A.note: spliced in by jq from flows/audio-48k-2ch-f32.json
half the ring: 200 ms at 48 kHz is 9600 samples, so ~4800. 1024 is well inside
a continuous flow's edit rate is its sample rate: this cursor counts samples
index is the exclusive END, so this opens [cursor, cursor+1024)
no range argument -- the writer remembers what OpenSamples opened

B.note: head mode gives head-1 on a continuous flow; +1 restores the exclusive end, so this is the newest 1024 samples
one batch past the head: must WAKE on lane A's next commit, ~500 ms into a 3 s deadline
unreachable: expect MXL_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TOO_EARLY with waited_ms ~500, never MXL_ERR_TIMEOUT
